description: Databricks connector (read-only). Surfaces Databricks Jobs — name, creator, schedule, format, created timestamp, and the latest run status (life-cycle/result state, run id, started-at, duration, cluster, triggered-by) — into the local index as `databricks:data_pipeline` items via the Jobs API 2.1 (`GET /api/2.1/jobs/list`, token-paginated, enriched from one page of `GET /api/2.1/jobs/runs/list`). Databricks Personal Access Token auth (sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`). Databricks has no universal SaaS host: the per-workspace URL is supplied via the `databricks.host` vault key and added to the sandbox network list at spawn time by `phase3AddDatabricksMcp`, so the static manifest network list is intentionally empty. v1 indexes jobs only — clusters, SQL warehouses, and notebooks/workspace listing are a deferred follow-up; `job.trigger` / `job.cancel` / `cluster.restart` (HITL) writes are deferred to Phase 6. No write tools.
author: Nimbus
